parsed.title: Character Companion Mini-Game Quests
parsed.oneLiner: Engage in daily mini-game quests with AI characters to earn free message credits and build companion bonds.

newMechanic.name: Daily Mini-Game Quests
newMechanic.description: A proactive daily quest system where users play brief mini-games with their AI character to earn credits.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Creates a predictable habit loop and monetization surface without altering core messaging pricing.

parsed.trigger: When opening the chat mode sheet, user taps the available character quest banner.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying guest users with remaining daily quest capacity.

offer.title: Play a Mini-Game
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game with Starship Galley to earn free credits.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Restricted to non-paying users with a strict daily cap sized well below the cheapest credit pack.

guardrails: Paid credit pack conversion rate non-inferiority within -3%
kpis.holdout: 90/10 user-level randomized holdout running for 28 days

risks: Users might ignore quests if credit yield is perceived as small
Quest fatigue if presented too frequently

newScreens.change: Add Daily Mini-Game Quest entry sheet for rewarded credits.

newElements.change: Quest banner button to launch rewarded mini-game with Starship Galley.

storyboard.caption: Users choose chat modes without earning extra credits.
Introduce daily mini-game quests for free credits.
Opt-in reward offer clearly states terms.
Verified reward instantly updates credit balance.
